hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon on Sustainable Transport Engineering
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students and young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: This hackathon challenges participants to solve real-world problems in sustainable transport engineering. Teams led by engineering students or young engineers work virtually to build solutions for released challenges.

hackathons.title: 2027 WFEO Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: Engineering students or young engineers under 30
hackathons.summary: The 2027 WFEO Hackathon invites engineering students and young engineers to solve real-world challenges in sustainable transport engineering. Participants work in multidisciplinary teams to build and submit innovative solutions for global impact.

hackathons.title: hackodisha-6.0
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students
hackathons.summary: hackodisha-6.0 is a community-driven online hackathon hosted on Devfolio. Participants collaborate remotely to build software projects without restrictive themes.

hackathons.title: Homingo Hack Days
hackathons.eligibility: Students and early-career developers across India
hackathons.summary: Homingo Hack Days is a free online AI engineering hackathon designed for students and early-career developers across India. Participants are challenged to build and ship innovative artificial intelligence and machine learning projects.

hackathons.title: Homingo Hack Days 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students in India
hackathons.summary: Homingo Hack Days is an online AI engineering hackathon open to participants across India. Developers focus on building AI agents, automations, and LLM applications.

hackathons.title: Crate-CTF 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and cybersecurity competitors
hackathons.summary: Crate-CTF 2026 is an online Jeopardy-style cybersecurity competition. Participants compete to solve security challenges across various computer science domains.

hackathons.title: Lean In Hacks 8.0
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students
hackathons.summary: Lean In Hacks 8.0 is a virtual student hackathon focusing on open-ended technical creation. Developers connect online to build and showcase innovative applications.

hackathons.title: micro1 Eval Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers
hackathons.summary: The micro1 Eval Hackathon 2026 is an online competition focused on evaluating and building innovative software and AI tools. Participants compete for a prize pool of $10,000 USD.

hackathons.title: 13th Protocol: An AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.location: KCC Institute of Technology & Management, Greater Noida
hackathons.eligibility: Open to engineering and technology students
hackathons.summary: An offline artificial intelligence hackathon held at KCC Institute in Greater Noida. Participants create AI-focused solutions and present their projects.

hackathons.title: AI + Blockchain Global University Autumn Camp Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: University students worldwide
hackathons.summary: This global student hackathon organized by Quack AI and Imperial College focuses on AI and blockchain innovation. University students worldwide compete to build Web3 and AI projects on the BNB Chain.

hackathons.title: BUILD 4 ALL
hackathons.eligibility: Students
hackathons.summary: BUILD 4 ALL is an online hackathon encouraging students to develop creative tech projects. Participants compete virtually to build functional software solutions and earn non-monetary recognition.

hackathons.title: SSOIndia Cybersecurity Hackathon and CTF
hackathons.eligibility: Students competing in teams of 2–3 members
hackathons.summary: This multi-stage cybersecurity competition features an online Mini-CTF, bootcamp, online hackathon, and a final onsite CTF challenge. Participants test their technical skills to design secure, privacy-preserving communication systems.

hackathons.title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers
hackathons.summary: The UGREEN Hackathon 2026 invites tech enthusiasts and students to build creative software applications. Competitors have the opportunity to win prizes from a total pool of $25,000.

hackathons.title: Capture the Flag by DSCI
hackathons.eligibility: Students, Researchers, Security Professionals
hackathons.summary: Data Security Council of India (DSCI) is hosting a Capture the Flag cybersecurity hackathon alongside the Annual Information Security Summit 2026. The competition features nine challenge areas ranging from GenAI to Cryptography.

hackathons.title: DSCI Capture the Flag Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students, researchers, and security professionals
hackathons.summary: The DSCI Capture the Flag hackathon features nine challenge areas ranging from GenAI to cryptography. Hosted alongside the Annual Information Security Summit 2026, it aims to recognize and reward top cybersecurity talent in the country.

hackathons.title: QNX Global Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers
hackathons.summary: The QNX Global Hackathon 2026 is a worldwide online developer challenge focused on embedded software systems and application development. A total prize pool of $46,000 is awarded to winning solutions.

hackathons.title: PayPal AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers
hackathons.summary: The PayPal AI Hackathon 2026 challenges participants to build intelligent applications using machine learning and AI technologies. Developers compete online to showcase novel software solutions.

hackathons.title: HackIndia Originals- FIN//NEXT 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to Computer Science students and developers
hackathons.summary: HackIndia Originals- FIN//NEXT 2027 is a virtual hackathon bringing together software builders to tackle modern technical challenges. Participants work remotely over several weeks to build and submit innovative projects.

hackathons.title: AWS Hackathon 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to Computer Science and engineering students
hackathons.summary: AWS Hackathon 2027 is a global online hackathon hosted by Amazon Web Services. Competitors build cloud-driven software solutions to win prizes exceeding $50,000.

hackathons.title: HackIndia Chennai Overdrive 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to Computer Science students and tech builders
hackathons.summary: HackIndia Chennai Overdrive 2027 is an in-person developer hackathon hosted in Chennai focusing on AI, ML, and Web3 technologies. Participants collaborate in teams over two days to build and present cutting-edge technical prototypes.

hackathons.title: Mailam Builds’27
hackathons.eligibility: Open to engineering and Computer Science students
hackathons.summary: Mailam Builds’27 is an offline engineering hackathon taking place at Mailam Engineering College. The event encourages students to design solutions leveraging artificial intelligence, Web3, and blockchain infrastructure.
